items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I've heard of him but I don't believe I've ever met him.

ctx.x: I've heard of him but I don't believe I've ever met him.
Yeah, we call him Jack Pierre. He was impressive. He'd been downtown for all his days, for years. Is he still alive? Yes, he's still alive. You all would like to get and take with him too?
I might have his address. I think he's the one I got a banjo from once. Did he ever play banjo? Or at least he sold a banjo. If he did, I can't remember.
